name: tree-authored-identity-kind-resolution
body: `tree_authored_identity` parses `apg/.trans/graph.jsonl` three times — via `code_universes_from_export`, via `code_kinds_from_export`, and for the `agent` records — and every code-universe FQN resolves at its recorded kind (the export's code record, else the plan store's declared `planned_node` kind), with `module` reserved for a FQN no record names. That fallback is defensive only: every well-formed universe FQN is record-named, and a plan declaration carrying no kind is rejected by ingest's planned-node admission before the fallback applies, so a stale or partial export cannot drop a recorded FQN's non-module kind-paired operation rows. Limit: three passes over the export. Upgrade: fold them into one parse if the tree digest becomes hot on large repos.
